Name: Cleaned
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: Cleaned, command: many)
SELECT replace(path, '/', '-') AS slug, trim(kind) AS tidy, lcase(kind) AS lowered, substr(path, 2) AS tail,
       date_diff('day', at, now()) AS age_days, YEAR(at) AS year, MONTH(day) AS month, DATE_FORMAT(at, '%Y') AS year_text
FROM events;
Template: SELECT ⟨c0 aliased:replace(path, '/', '-')⟩ AS slug, ⟨c1 aliased:trim(kind)⟩ AS tidy, ⟨c2 aliased:lcase(kind)⟩ AS lowered, ⟨c3 aliased:substr(path, 2)⟩ AS tail,\n       ⟨c4 aliased:date_diff('day', at, now())⟩ AS age_days, ⟨c5 aliased:YEAR(at)⟩ AS year, ⟨c6 aliased:MONTH(day)⟩ AS month, ⟨c7 aliased:DATE_FORMAT(at, '%Y')⟩ AS year_text\nFROM events;

Name: Totals
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: Totals, command: many)
SELECT user_id, any_value(kind) AS some_kind, group_concat(kind) AS kinds, array_agg(path) AS paths,
       medianExact(bytes) AS median_bytes, medianExactIf(bytes, kind = 'view') AS median_view_bytes,
       medianTDigest(duration) AS median_duration, BIT_AND(flags) AS common_flags, STDDEV_POP(duration) AS spread
FROM events
GROUP BY user_id;
Template:
SELECT ⟨c0:user_id⟩, ⟨c1 aliased:any_value(kind)⟩ AS some_kind, ⟨c2 aliased:group_concat(kind)⟩ AS kinds, ⟨c3 aliased:array_agg(path)⟩ AS paths,
       ⟨c4 aliased:medianExact(bytes)⟩ AS median_bytes, ⟨c5 aliased:medianExactIf(bytes, kind = 'view')⟩ AS median_view_bytes,
       ⟨c6 aliased:medianTDigest(duration)⟩ AS median_duration, ⟨c7 aliased:BIT_AND(flags)⟩ AS common_flags, ⟨c8 aliased:STDDEV_POP(duration)⟩ AS spread
FROM events
GROUP BY user_id;

Name: Labels
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: Labels, command: many)
SELECT transform(kind, ['view', 'click'], ['Viewed', 'Clicked'], 'Other') AS label,
       formatReadableSize(bytes) AS size, formatReadableTimeDelta(duration) AS took,
       splitByRegexp('/', path) AS segments, throwIf(bytes < 0, 'negative size') AS checked
FROM events;
Template:
SELECT ⟨c0 aliased:transform(kind, ['view', 'click'], ['Viewed', 'Clicked'], 'Other')⟩ AS label,
       ⟨c1 aliased:formatReadableSize(bytes)⟩ AS size, ⟨c2 aliased:formatReadableTimeDelta(duration)⟩ AS took,
       ⟨c3 aliased:splitByRegexp('/', path)⟩ AS segments, ⟨c4 aliased:throwIf(bytes < 0, 'negative size')⟩ AS checked
FROM events;

Name: Funnel
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: Funnel, command: many)
SELECT user_id, windowFunnel(3600)(at, kind = 'view', kind = 'cart', kind = 'buy') AS reached,
       retention(kind = 'view', kind = 'buy') AS retained
FROM events
GROUP BY user_id;
Template:
SELECT ⟨c0:user_id⟩, ⟨c1 aliased:windowFunnel(3600)(at, kind = 'view', kind = 'cart', kind = 'buy')⟩ AS reached,
       ⟨c2 aliased:retention(kind = 'view', kind = 'buy')⟩ AS retained
FROM events
GROUP BY user_id;

Name: Latency
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: Latency, command: one)
SELECT quantileTDigest(0.95)(duration) AS p95, quantileTiming(0.99)(duration) AS p99,
       quantilesTDigest(0.5, 0.9)(duration) AS spread
FROM events;
Template: SELECT ⟨c0 aliased:quantileTDigest(0.95)(duration)⟩ AS p95, ⟨c1 aliased:quantileTiming(0.99)(duration)⟩ AS p99,\n       ⟨c2 aliased:quantilesTDigest(0.5, 0.9)(duration)⟩ AS spread\nFROM events;

Name: Buckets
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: Buckets, command: many)
SELECT toStartOfInterval(at, INTERVAL 15 MINUTE) AS quarter_hour, toStartOfInterval(day, INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AS month_start,
       toStartOfInterval(at_precise, INTERVAL 100 MILLISECOND) AS tick, time_bucket(at, INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AS hour,
       count() AS events
FROM events
GROUP BY quarter_hour, month_start, tick, hour;
Template:
SELECT ⟨c0 aliased:toStartOfInterval(at, INTERVAL 15 MINUTE)⟩ AS quarter_hour, ⟨c1 aliased:toStartOfInterval(day, INTERVAL 1 MONTH)⟩ AS month_start,
       ⟨c2 aliased:toStartOfInterval(at_precise, INTERVAL 100 MILLISECOND)⟩ AS tick, ⟨c3 aliased:time_bucket(at, INTERVAL 1 HOUR)⟩ AS hour,
       ⟨c4 aliased:count()⟩ AS events
FROM events
GROUP BY quarter_hour, month_start, tick, hour;

Name: Calendar
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: Calendar, command: many)
SELECT toYYYYMM(day) AS month_key, toYYYYMMDD(at) AS day_key, toMonday(day) AS week_start,
       toLastDayOfMonth(at) AS month_end, toStartOfFiveMinutes(at) AS five_minutes,
       toStartOfMillisecond(at_precise) AS millisecond, toDateTime(at_precise) AS whole_second, toDateTime(day) AS midnight,
       at + toIntervalHour(1) AS next_hour, fromUnixTimestamp(bytes) AS from_epoch
FROM events;
Template:
SELECT ⟨c0 aliased:toYYYYMM(day)⟩ AS month_key, ⟨c1 aliased:toYYYYMMDD(at)⟩ AS day_key, ⟨c2 aliased:toMonday(day)⟩ AS week_start,
       ⟨c3 aliased:toLastDayOfMonth(at)⟩ AS month_end, ⟨c4 aliased:toStartOfFiveMinutes(at)⟩ AS five_minutes,
       ⟨c5 aliased:toStartOfMillisecond(at_precise)⟩ AS millisecond, ⟨c6 aliased:toDateTime(at_precise)⟩ AS whole_second, ⟨c7 aliased:toDateTime(day)⟩ AS midnight,
       ⟨c8 aliased:at + toIntervalHour(1)⟩ AS next_hour, ⟨c9 aliased:fromUnixTimestamp(bytes)⟩ AS from_epoch
FROM events;
